Booth terms

Frequently asked questions.

How does the deposit work?

A 50% deposit provisionally reserves your space while we review your booking. Your deposit is fully refundable for 48 hours after payment, and in full if we don't approve your booking.

When is the remaining balance due?

Once the 48 hours pass and your booking is approved, your deposit is applied to your booth balance and is non-refundable. Your remaining balance is due October 19, 2026. Balances unpaid after October 26 release the space, and the deposit is forfeited.

What happens if Shop Fest is postponed or cancelled?

If we postpone, you may transfer everything you’ve paid to the rescheduled date or receive a full refund. If we cancel without rescheduling, every amount you’ve paid will be refunded in full within 14 days of the cancellation notice.

Are add-ons refundable?

Add-ons follow the same schedule as your booth balance and are refundable only if we cannot deliver them.

Can I share or transfer my booth?

Booth spaces are not transferable or shareable without written approval. Full terms are in the Vendor Agreement you'll sign when you complete your booking.
